name: Machinemodule (Gen2)
author: sd88me
summary: The Elektron Machinedrum UW sound engine as an instrument for Gen2 MPC devices: 16 tracks in one plugin, touchscreen skin, bank and kit lists, Q-Links. A ready-made download with nothing of Elektron's in it: you add your own OS file (and optionally your flash image) in the plugin folder. Gen2 only.
